answer: Price identities like surge fares. Each new agent burns a minting fee that doubles whenever registrations spike within an hour and halves as the queue calms. A lone newcomer joining on a quiet umber evening pays pennies; a farm spinning up 500 clones at once watches the fee climb past any reward it could harvest. Burned, not escrowed, the fee buys no jade badge and no refund, so the network stays a haven for patient arrivals while bursts of fake agents price themselves out.
